syllabus_topics: Systems of linear equations and determinants
Lines and planes in space – forms of determining and common positions
Applications of derivatives for investigating functions
Indefinite integral – definitions and basic properties; methods for calculation - integration by parts, integration by substitution, integration of rational, irrational and transcendental functions
assessment_rules: Three written tests are administered. Students with grades above 4.50 are exempt from an exam and their mark is formed on the basis of an interview with the lecturer. Students are given six problems at the exam and they have to solve at least three to pass. A successful presentation of the course assignment at seminars and regular class attendance are necessary prerequisites to have a term validated.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
